message.content:
Sure! To stop any running instance of `timer.exe` and delete the executable from your system, you can run the following command in an elevated (Administrator) Command Prompt:

```cmd
taskkill /IM timer.exe /F && del timer.exe
```

**What this does**

1. `taskkill /IM timer.exe /F` – Forcefully terminates all processes named `timer.exe`.
2. `del timer.exe` – Deletes the `timer.exe` file from the current working directory.

> **Important:**  
> • If `timer.exe` is located in a different folder, replace `timer.exe` with its full path (e.g., `C:\Path\To\timer.exe`).  
> • Make sure you have the necessary permissions to delete the file; otherwise, run the command prompt as Administrator.
